types.description: ET 200S 2AO U ST; assembled field-interface abstraction with TM-E15C24-01; partial backplane coverage

modelingNotes: Field terminals refer to the assembled TM-E15C24-01 arrangement documented on p.8; clamps are on a separately ordered terminal module, not included with this electronic card. This base choice is not an as-built assertion.
Other compatible bases have AUX1 terminals A3/A4/A7/A8. They are separate-base features, absent from the chosen 24-01 arrangement. No PE or screen clamp is invented.
P1=L+ and P2=1M are internal supply-contact identities from p.8, not external field clamps. Backplane individual signal contacts and card-to-base mating positions are not enumerated.

24 VDC load supply from power module; maximum module consumption 130 mA. Analog ranges +/-10 V or 1-5 V; load at least 1 kohm, capacitance at most 1 microfarad. Range limits are not assigned nominal voltage.
Only 3-7 is a verified fixed link (p.8 MANA bus); instantiate it as an explicit jumper. Never link P2 to MANA automatically. Two-wire sense bridges are application wiring, not factory continuity.

Channels and sense functions do not join nets or simulate output regulation. Channel use is optional by application; P1/P2 supply presence is required. Shared common connections permit the fixed jumper and field lead, without asserting clamp wire capacity.

Assembled field-interface abstraction on documented TM-E15C24-01 (6ES7193-4CB30-0AA0): eight field clamps, no AUX clamps. Card and base are separately ordered. Verify the installed per-slot pairing before use. Do not duplicate these field clamps with a second base instance in the same circuit.

Partial physical inventory: numbered clamps belong to the selected separate base; P1/P2 identify internal functional supplies, not every mating finger. Backplane contacts, actual per-slot pairing and external shield/bonding hardware remain unverified. No additional PE or AUX bond is inferred.
